d: Small, plump, rodent-like creature with cream and golden-tan fur and a determined expression in its small, dark, beady eyes. It wears a deep indigo hood, a crimson textured scarf, a golden-brown quilted tunic with a brown belt, and deep reddish-brown trousers. The creature carries a large, off-white stone sword on its back, holds a golden circular bow in one hand, and carries a round silver shield. BODY COLOR: Golden-tan and cream LEGS: Plantigrade with small, dark paws
